text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
One day, I'm walking past a pet shop,
when...

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Oh, these poor, hapless souls! How I
wish to
protect them!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Yaeno Muteki is staring at some cute
animals with
an anguished expression.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
That kitten and puppy... How full of
unbridled
innocence their wide eyes are.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
No doubt they lack the power to survive
on their
own, much unlike their wild
counterparts...

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
But don't you worry... My art, the Kongo
Yaegaki
style of fighting, exists to
protect the weak and
the innocent!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
I shall guard this store as your protector
until all
of you find your rightful
masters...

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
choice_data_list: Isn't that taking things a bit too...

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Did... Did you witness all of that just
now?

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Did... Did you witness all of that just
now?

You've got an interesting side to ...
You've got an interesting side to ...

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Training! Yes! I was doing just that!
choice_data_list: You looked like you were in the mi...
You've got an interesting side to ...
You've got an interesting side to ...

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
I was strengthening my resolve by
allowing my
emotions to run rampant!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
It is a brutal and painful method, but it
is all a
part of my martial arts training!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
As Yaeno Muteki stands there, sweat
glistening
on her brow, she does seem
quite formidable.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Yaeno Muteki runs off and veers around
the
corner of the street with
unparalleled skill.
